title: galium parisiense var. anglicum
intro: Galium parisiense var. anglicum, commonly known as English cleavers, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, such as eczema and acne. The therapeutic actions of English cleavers include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and diuretic properties, which help to soothe and calm irritated skin and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy and potential side effects.
